Generated Narrative: ValueSet speiro-provider-identity-outcome

  • Include these codes as defined in https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-identity-outcome version 📦0.2.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    match-confirmedMatch confirmedThe identity comparison confirmed a match under the applicable identity rule.
    no-matchNo matchThe identity comparison did not confirm a match.
    not-completedNot completedThe identity verification attempt was not completed.
    source-unavailableIdentity source unavailableThe identity source was unavailable: a source condition, not a request or match lifecycle state. Use only when the source condition is itself known; absence of a result alone does not establish source unavailability.
    not-attemptedNot attemptedThe selected comparison is explicitly reported or independently established as not attempted. Absence of a reported result alone does not establish this outcome. Preserve whether the supporting status was reported or derived and its supported reason.

name: SpeiroProviderIdentityOutcomeVS
title: Speiro Provider Identity Outcome ValueSet
description: Provider comparison outcomes only. Client-only calibration and usable-face outcomes are excluded; override and simulation cannot establish a real match.
